props.text: We design interiors people move into and keep using, not rooms that photograph well and need fixing within a year.

One visit to measure the space and learn how you actually live in it. Three layouts to choose from. Then drawings, an itemised quote, and a schedule built around real supplier lead times — signed before anything is ordered. One team stays responsible from the first sketch to the final snag list.

items.label: from survey to drawings and quote
Survey and measure
items.text: A morning in the space: every wall measured, every socket noted, and a record of how each room actually gets used.

items.label: Three layouts
items.text: Three floor plans and a first material palette. You pick one; it becomes the plan everything else is built from.

items.label: Drawings and quote
items.text: Technical drawings, finish schedule and a quote itemised per trade. Nothing is ordered until you sign it.

items.label: Joinery off site
items.text: Cabinets and wardrobes are built in the workshop while electrics and plumbing are re-routed in the flat.

items.label: Install and snag list
items.text: Everything goes in, we walk the rooms with you, and the list is closed before we hand over the keys.

props.title: Drawings that match the site
props.description: We re-measure every wall, outlet and ceiling height before drawing. The render you approve is the same plan the joiners work from, so what arrives in the room is what you signed off on.

visual.alt: Living room with a long sofa, low coffee table and built-in wall shelving

props.title: A kitchen built around cooking
props.description: Counter height follows whoever cooks most. Sink, hob and fridge sit along the path you actually walk while making dinner, not the path a catalogue layout assumes.

visual.alt: Kitchen open to a dining area, with flat-front cabinetry and daylight from a large window

props.title: Bedrooms dark enough to sleep
props.description: Two-layer curtains, reading lights on their own switch, sockets at the head of the bed. Surfaces are chosen because they wipe clean — a bedroom is lived in daily, not photographed once.

visual.alt: Bedroom with an upholstered headboard, light bedding and reading lights on both sides

quotes.quote: We signed in March and slept in the finished flat eleven weeks later. Nothing on the handover list took more than a day to close out.
quotes.author: Elin Sandoval

quotes.quote: The joinery quote never moved. Every line in the contract was the line we paid.
quotes.author: Peter Laval

quotes.quote: They worked one room at a time so we could keep living here with a six-year-old.
quotes.author: Nadia Brecht

props.title: The crew is ours
props.text: Joiners, electricians and painters are on our payroll, not hired per job. The site manager you meet at the survey is the one who signs off your handover list eleven weeks later.
